# run honors the verification mode and finalizes sesam's own profiles.

exec git init
exec git config user.email test@sesam.dev
exec git config user.name 'Sesam Test'
exec sesam init --user admin
cp raw-fixture raw.txt
exec sesam add raw.txt
rm raw.txt

exec sesam --verify-mode no-disk run --secret RAW=raw.txt -- touch started-no-disk
exists started-no-disk

exec sesam --cpuprofile cpu.pprof run --secret RAW=raw.txt -- touch started-cpu
exists cpu.pprof
exists started-cpu

exec sesam run --secret RAW=raw.txt --cpuprofile cpu-after.pprof -- touch started-cpu-after
exists cpu-after.pprof
exists started-cpu-after

exec sesam --memprofile mem.pprof run --secret RAW=raw.txt -- touch started-mem
exists mem.pprof
exists started-mem

exec sesam run --secret RAW=raw.txt --verify-mode no-disk -- touch started-no-disk-after
exists started-no-disk-after

# An extra object changes the root hash but not the selected secret itself.
cp .sesam/objects/raw.txt.sesam .sesam/objects/extra.txt.sesam
! exec sesam run --secret RAW=raw.txt -- touch started-default
stderr 'root hash mismatch'
! exists started-default

! exec sesam --verify-mode all run --secret RAW=raw.txt -- touch started-all
stderr 'root hash mismatch'
! exists started-all

exec sesam --verify-mode no-disk run --secret RAW=raw.txt -- sh -c 'cat "$RAW"'
cmp stdout raw-fixture
exec sesam run --verify-mode no-disk --secret RAW=raw.txt -- sh -c 'cat "$RAW"'
cmp stdout raw-fixture
rm .sesam/objects/extra.txt.sesam

# Invalid modes are rejected regardless of flag position.
! exec sesam --verify-mode invalid run --secret RAW=raw.txt -- touch started-invalid
stderr 'invalid verify mode: invalid'
! exists started-invalid
! exec sesam run --verify-mode invalid --secret RAW=raw.txt -- touch started-invalid-after
stderr 'invalid verify mode: invalid'
! exists started-invalid-after

# Skipping the root-hash check does not bypass verification of selected secrets.
cp .sesam/objects/raw.txt.sesam $TMPDIR/raw-object
cp raw-fixture .sesam/objects/raw.txt.sesam
! exec sesam --verify-mode no-disk run --secret RAW=raw.txt -- touch started-corrupt
stderr 'read secret raw.txt:'
! exists started-corrupt
cp $TMPDIR/raw-object .sesam/objects/raw.txt.sesam

-- raw-fixture --
raw
